messages:
Samir: Heads-up — saw a bump this morning in structured-validate rejects for fncall on the /classify route. spike started ~1748208000 and lines up with the model-variant roll. quotas are being charged to the degen route and console billing looks messy. anyone digging?
Aya: saw it too. when validator is strict we route to degen and that increments degen quota. feels wrong for customer billing and makes dashboards noisy.
Ravi: this matches my local repro. payloads often have small shape differences (extra nulls) — not malicious. Proposal: add a 'soft-fail' validation mode: accept response, return to client, but tag telemetry with validation=soft_fail and an error_code so console can surface it. keep billing attributed to original route.
Keely: i'm worried about toolhooks: if we let malformed payloads through, downstream adapters could crash. soft-fail needs an option to sanitize or coerce before passing to tools.
Samir: agree. idea: router/runtime emits both raw_response and validated_payload in telemetry. when sanitize_for_hooks=true, we forward validated_payload to toolhooks; otherwise forward raw_response. this preserves UX while reducing crash surface.
Aya: console needs a first-class signal — "validation-warning" in the route timeline + filter by validation tag. Also want sampling controls so we don't flood logs/dashboards.
Ravi: sampling plan: increment metric counters for every request, but only store full payloads for sampled requests (default sample_rate=0.01). telemetry fields I'd like: validation_mode, validation_result, validation_score, sample_payload (true/false), original_route, billed_route, route_variant.
Keely: config sketch (for runtime + router):
```yaml
routes:
  - name: classify
    validation:
      mode: soft  # strict|soft|off
      sample_rate: 0.01
      sanitize_for_hooks: true
    rollout:
      canary: 0.01
      metrics: ["validation_rate", "error_rate", "toolhook_failures"]
```
Samir: alert thresholds proposal: validation_rate > 5% over 10m OR > 100 rejects/hr -> page, and a softer ops Slack alert at 1%.
Aya: question: if billing stays on original_route, do we need a change in ETL so the degen route doesn't get charged? we currently map usage by final routed endpoint.
Ravi: yes — billing ETL must prefer billed_route tag when present. implement in two phases: 1) add billed_route tag to telemetry and have ETL honor it; 2) backfill mapping for last two weeks for customers on canary (audit only).
ops-bot: deploy plan recommended: canary 1% -> 10% -> 100% with health checks on: validation_rate, toolhook_error_rate, p50/p95 latency. auto-rollback if validation_rate > 2x baseline AND toolhook_error_rate > 0.5%.
Keely: Console UX asks: add a toggle "Show soft-fails" that overlays validation warnings onto existing per-route timelines and cost views. also tooltip: "soft-fail = returned to caller but failed schema check; may be coerced for downstream hooks."
Samir: follow-ups: 1) RFC (billing + telemetry) 2) small runtime PR (emit validation tags + sample payloads) 3) console mockups and dashboard panel. I'll take RFC. Aya — can you produce mockups? Ravi — runtime prototype? Keely — confirm rollout metrics for console. :thumbsup:
Aya: on it — will mock a filter + tooltip and a short panel showing sampled payloads.
Ravi: prototype telemetry envelope and a small sanitizer for toolhooks by EOD.
Samir: thanks all. I'll open the RFC and assign the follow-ups. moving discussion there for sign-off.
